stages.blurb: Two apps (customer and driver/host) share one front door. Photos already come from a nearby CDN.
Matching people and quoting a price are their own services—not one database query.
Phones send location often. A geo index plus cache, and a separate ETA service, keep maps snappy.
Live trips, the catalog of listings, and pictures are three different stores.
After you tap, notify the other side and take payment in the background so the app does not freeze.
Push alerts and turn-by-turn routing keep both people updated on the road.
